R._noteR_order: HIT ORDER (Cowork 2026-07-16 hit-order audit): the %MISSING hit (MissingHealthDamage) is ordered FIRST, before the flat TotalExplosionDamage. R is one instantaneous cast (flat 150/200/250+100%AP TRUE + 25% target MISSING hp TRUE), so the %missing must read the PRE-cast missing. The engine re-evaluates a Missing-HP hit against RUNNING HP, so with the flat hit first it reduced HP and the %missing hit double-counted its own explosion (overcount = 0.25 x explosion). Flat is HP-independent, so ordering it second is inert. Same class as Kindred E; Garen R already orders %missing-first.
